title: Crafting recipe file (data/crafting/<id>.json, one recipe per file)
description: Something made at the workbench or smelted in the furnace at the hero's home (GDD §14, TECH_DESIGN §28): where it is made, what it needs, what it makes, and when the hero knows it. Every item id must be in data/items. The workbench lists every recipe of its own that the hero knows, in 'order'; the furnace offers its own. Adding one needs no code. (Cooking has its own folder and schema: data/recipes, recipe.schema.json.)

name.description: What the list calls it. Left out, it is the name of the item it makes. A recipe that makes a furnishing needs one.

station.description: Where it is made. A 'furnace' recipe is smelted overnight, several to a load (data/rules/crafting.json: furnace_most), and must make an item.

order.description: Its place on its station's list, lowest first; recipes that share a number are listed by id.

needs.description: What is used up, each with how many. A tool made from another names the old tool here.

makes.description: An item for the pack, or a furnishing of the hero's home: one of the two.

furnishing.description: One of the furnishings in data/rules/crafting.json. It is made once, and stands in its own place in the cottage (a Furnishing node of that id in the home's scene).

unlock.description: When the hero knows the recipe. Left out, from the start. One of the two: an item 'found' (ever held, even if he has none now), or a 'skill' at a 'level'.

level.description: Every skill begins at level 1, so 2 is the first that waits on anything.
